animations.name: Victory Turbo 49 Centered v2
animations.prompt: Compact victory for Oscar in 16-bit pixel art, right-facing side view, preserving exact identity, outfit, and proportions. Fixed camera, full body always visible, no zoom, no crop, no frame-edge contact. Keep scale close to idle: body about 340-360 px high inside 512x512, with stable margins like idle (top 80-100 px, bottom 70-90 px). Use restrained celebration: chest-level fist pump, subtle torso rhythm, small footwork and weight shifts. Avoid overhead arms. Transparent background.
